## Purpose

Renders the Analytics page — token usage, spend, success rate, and per-pipeline/per-model
breakdowns for the signed-in user's runs — fetched from a single server-aggregated summary
endpoint. Mounted by `DashboardLayout` when `mainView === "analytics"`.

## Shape

- [AnalyticsPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsPage.tsx) — **owns all state**: date/pipeline/model filters, the
  `getAnalyticsSummary`/`getPreferences` fetches, and derived display values (formatted
  tokens/cost, KPI percentages, the signed prompt-caching delta). Only the date filter
  re-queries the server; pipeline/model filters narrow the already-fetched rollup arrays
  client-side. Renders stat cards, a daily-activity chart, a success-rate donut, and
  pipeline/model breakdown bars.
- [charts/BarChart.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/analytics/charts/BarChart.tsx) and [charts/DonutChart.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/analytics/charts/DonutChart.tsx) — generic, data-prop-driven SVG/flex chart
  primitives extracted from what was originally inline geometry in `AnalyticsPage`. Both take
  `ariaLabel` for a single accessible text alternative and accept an optional `status` flag to
  pull from the status color ramp instead of the default brand chroma.

## Why this shape

The charts were pulled out of the page into standalone primitives specifically so they carry
no workflow-name branching and no analytics-specific logic — **`BarChart`/`DonutChart` are pure
presentation components** that could render any labeled series, while `AnalyticsPage` keeps all
the analytics domain logic (filters, formatting, KPI math) in one place rather than spreading it
across chart components.
